deliveryLeadership.title: Delivery & Leadership
skills: Engagement ownership across enterprise accounts in LATAM and EMEA, driving value delivery, client satisfaction, and contract renewals in pharmaceutical and technology sectors.
Executive stakeholder management and strategic consulting — translating business needs into multi-quarter delivery roadmaps and advising C-level and senior stakeholders.
Portfolio and resource management at scale, including P&L ownership, engagement economics, and team scaling from startup to 30+ FTE delivery organizations.
Cross-cultural delivery leadership across LATAM and EMEA, with hybrid agile and predictive methodologies, and risk and escalation management for complex enterprise programs.

dataPlatform.title: Data Platform & Architecture
skills: Extensive experience designing and overseeing modern data platforms in cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure), including data lakes, data warehouses, and data marts for enterprise clients.
Proven track record leading legacy data system migrations to modern architectures, with robust data governance frameworks ensuring data quality, compliance, and reliability.
Deep expertise in data platform tooling — dbt, Dagster, Airflow, Snowflake, and Databricks — spanning both hands-on engineering and delivery leadership across 10+ end-to-end engagements.
Strong background in data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, and pipeline development, ensuring efficient data flow and transformation at scale.
